note: Oil and gas rebounded on 11 November after Monday's sharp slide: Brent rose to about $93.43/bbl, WTI to about $87.12/bbl and TTF to about €86.91/MWh, all up roughly 2% on the day but still down about 10-12% from Nov 3. Reuters reported a record 37 tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz in October, citing Washington Institute for Near East Policy data, and Ukrainian drones set fire to Russia's second-largest refinery at Kirishi on Nov 9 — both adding to the risk premium even as Iraq's reported Hormuz understanding and sanctioned-tanker license talks weigh the other way.
